module Components
  module_function

  def strong(adjacency)
    count = adjacency.length
    indices = Array.new(count)
    low = Array.new(count)
    active = Array.new(count, false)
    members = []
    groups = []
    serial = 0
    count.times do |start|
      next unless indices[start].nil?

      indices[start] = low[start] = serial
      serial += 1
      active[start] = true
      members << start
      frames = [[start, 0]]
      until frames.empty?
        vertex, cursor = frames[-1]
        if cursor < adjacency[vertex].length
          other = adjacency[vertex][cursor]
          frames[-1][1] += 1
          if indices[other].nil?
            indices[other] = low[other] = serial
            serial += 1
            active[other] = true
            members << other
            frames << [other, 0]
          elsif active[other]
            low[vertex] = [low[vertex], indices[other]].min
          end
          next
        end
        frames.pop
        if low[vertex] == indices[vertex]
          group = []
          loop do
            other = members.pop
            active[other] = false
            group << other
            break if other == vertex
          end
          groups << group.sort
        end
        unless frames.empty?
          parent = frames[-1][0]
          low[parent] = [low[parent], low[vertex]].min
        end
      end
    end
    groups.sort_by(&:first)
  end

  def reachable(adjacency, starts)
    seen = Array.new(adjacency.length, false)
    stack = starts.sort.reverse
    until stack.empty?
      vertex = stack.pop
      next if seen[vertex]

      seen[vertex] = true
      adjacency[vertex].reverse_each { |other| stack << other unless seen[other] }
    end
    seen
  end

  def distances(adjacency, starts)
    distances = Array.new(adjacency.length, -1)
    queue = starts.sort.uniq
    queue.each { |vertex| distances[vertex] = 0 }
    cursor = 0
    while cursor < queue.length
      vertex = queue[cursor]
      cursor += 1
      adjacency[vertex].each do |other|
        next unless distances[other] == -1

        distances[other] = distances[vertex] + 1
        queue << other
      end
    end
    distances
  end

  def weak(adjacency)
    seen = Array.new(adjacency.length, false)
    groups = []
    adjacency.each_index do |start|
      next if seen[start]

      group = []
      stack = [start]
      seen[start] = true
      until stack.empty?
        vertex = stack.pop
        group << vertex
        adjacency[vertex].each do |other|
          next if seen[other]

          seen[other] = true
          stack << other
        end
      end
      groups << group.sort
    end
    groups
  end
end

module GraphIO
  Page = Struct.new(:id, :host, :title, :words, keyword_init: true)
  Link = Struct.new(:line, :source, :destination, keyword_init: true)
  Query = Struct.new(:words, :seeds, keyword_init: true)
  Data = Struct.new(:pages, :links, :queries, :settings, keyword_init: true)

  def self.read
    pages = File.readlines('input/pages.csv', chomp: true).drop(1).map do |line|
      id, host, title = line.split(',')
      Page.new(id: id.to_i, host: host, title: title, words: title.split)
    end.sort_by(&:id)
    links = File.readlines('input/links.csv', chomp: true).drop(1).each_with_index.map do |line, index|
      source, destination = line.split(',').map(&:to_i)
      Link.new(line: index + 2, source: source, destination: destination)
    end
    queries = File.readlines('input/queries.txt', chomp: true).map do |line|
      words, seeds = line.split(' | ')
      Query.new(words: words.split, seeds: seeds.split.map(&:to_i))
    end
    settings = {}
    File.foreach('input/params.txt') do |line|
      name, *values = line.split
      settings[name.downcase.to_sym] = case name
                                      when 'DAMPING', 'TOLERANCE', 'SPAM_THRESHOLD' then values[0].to_f
                                      when 'DAMPING_SWEEP' then values.map(&:to_f)
                                      when 'TRUSTED' then values.map(&:to_i)
                                      else values[0].to_i
                                      end
    end
    Data.new(pages: pages, links: links, queries: queries, settings: settings)
  end
end

module HITS
  def self.compute(count, nodes, edges, iterations)
    nodes = nodes.sort
    incoming = Array.new(count) { [] }
    outgoing = Array.new(count) { [] }
    edges.each do |source, destination|
      incoming[destination] << source
      outgoing[source] << destination
    end
    incoming.each(&:sort!)
    outgoing.each(&:sort!)
    authorities = Array.new(count, 0.0)
    hubs = Array.new(count, 0.0)
    nodes.each { |vertex| authorities[vertex] = hubs[vertex] = 1.0 }
    iterations.times do
      raw_authorities = Array.new(count, 0.0)
      raw_hubs = Array.new(count, 0.0)
      nodes.each do |vertex|
        incoming[vertex].each { |source| raw_authorities[vertex] += hubs[source] }
      end
      nodes.each do |vertex|
        outgoing[vertex].each { |destination| raw_hubs[vertex] += raw_authorities[destination] }
      end
      authority_norm = 0.0
      hub_norm = 0.0
      nodes.each do |vertex|
        authority_norm += raw_authorities[vertex] * raw_authorities[vertex]
        hub_norm += raw_hubs[vertex] * raw_hubs[vertex]
      end
      authority_norm = Math.sqrt(authority_norm)
      hub_norm = Math.sqrt(hub_norm)
      nodes.each do |vertex|
        authorities[vertex] = raw_authorities[vertex] / authority_norm
        hubs[vertex] = raw_hubs[vertex] / hub_norm
      end
    end
    { authority: authorities, hub: hubs }
  end
end

module PageRank
  Result = Struct.new(:values, :changes, :converged, keyword_init: true)

  def self.compute(count, edges, seeds, damping, iterations, tolerance)
    weights = Array.new(count, 0)
    incoming = Array.new(count) { [] }
    edges.each do |source, destination, weight|
      weights[source] += weight
      incoming[destination] << [source, weight]
    end
    incoming.each { |list| list.sort_by!(&:first) }
    teleport = Array.new(count, false)
    seeds.each { |vertex| teleport[vertex] = true }
    size = seeds.length
    values = Array.new(count) { |vertex| teleport[vertex] ? 1.0 / size : 0.0 }
    changes = []
    converged = nil
    1.upto(iterations) do |iteration|
      dangling = 0.0
      count.times { |vertex| dangling += values[vertex] if weights[vertex].zero? }
      base = ((1.0 - damping) + damping * dangling) / size
      updated = Array.new(count, 0.0)
      count.times do |vertex|
        inflow = 0.0
        incoming[vertex].each { |source, weight| inflow += (values[source] * weight) / weights[source] }
        updated[vertex] = damping * inflow
        updated[vertex] += base if teleport[vertex]
      end
      change = 0.0
      count.times { |vertex| change += (updated[vertex] - values[vertex]).abs }
      changes << change
      converged ||= iteration if change < tolerance
      values = updated
    end
    Result.new(values: values, changes: changes, converged: converged)
  end
end

module Report
  module_function

  def real(value, places = 6)
    text = format("%.#{places}f", value)
    text.start_with?('-') && text.to_f.zero? ? text[1..] : text
  end

  def scaled(value, places = 6)
    real(value, places).delete('.').to_i
  end

  def fraction(numerator, denominator)
    divisor = numerator.abs.gcd(denominator)
    numerator = numerator.div(divisor)
    denominator = denominator.div(divisor)
    "#{numerator}/#{denominator} #{real(numerator.to_f / denominator, 4)}"
  end

  def write(name, lines)
    Dir.mkdir('output') unless Dir.exist?('output')
    File.binwrite(File.join('output', name), lines.empty? ? '' : lines.join("\n") + "\n")
  end
end
